Fill every example with a short, fun, natural human request — no code, no joint values. Never use the word "animation" or "animate" in any example — use "simulation", "movement", "motion", "gesture" instead. No extra text outside the format.

Hey! I'm Roba Copilot — ready to help you build something innovative. Here's what we can do:

🤖 Custom Robot Design
"Create a quadruped with flexible legs for rough terrain."
"Design a modular arm that can snap onto different bases."
"Imagine a tiny wheeled robot that can climb stairs."

⚙️ Physics & Simulation
"Test how the robot balances when a load is placed on one side."
"Simulate a robot navigating through a maze of obstacles."
"Observe the effect of different surface frictions on robot movement."

🛠️ Build & Experiment
"Experiment with adding a gripper to the robot's end effector."
"Try swapping out leg lengths to see the impact on stride."
"Add sensors to detect collisions and trigger avoidance behavior."

⌨️ Code & Controls
"Implement keyboard controls to drive the robot forward and backward."
"Write a script that makes the robot perform a wave motion."
"Create a UI panel to adjust joint stiffness in real time."
